voxel.name: Voxel blocks
voxel.tagline: A blocky voxel world: cube terrain, square trees, pixel textures.
voxel.look: blocky voxel game world, everything built from perfect cubes, crisp 16x16 pixel textures on every block, square trees and cube clouds, bright saturated daylight, isometric-friendly framing, render-engine sharpness
voxel.character: a blocky character with a cube head, rectangular body and limbs, a simple pixel-texture face and outfit, no fingers
voxel.finish: clean voxel render, sharp block edges, no smooth curves
voxel.negative: smooth surfaces, round shapes, realistic humans, photo, blur, text, logos, watermark, game interface, existing game characters
voxel.motion: blocky stepped movement, blocks pop in and out one at a time, camera glides like a flying spectator
voxel.tips: Ask the model for 'voxel' and 'made of cubes'; never name a game in the prompt.

3d-realistic.name: 3D realistic
3d-realistic.tagline: Photoreal CGI, like a high-end game cinematic or a VFX shot.
3d-realistic.look: photorealistic 3D render, physically based materials, ray-traced global illumination, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, 35mm anamorphic lens look, volumetric haze, ultra-detailed textures
3d-realistic.character: a realistic adult character with natural skin texture, believable proportions and practical clothing
3d-realistic.finish: high dynamic range, film-quality CGI, subtle lens bloom
3d-realistic.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, logos, watermark, oversaturated
3d-realistic.motion: slow dolly or crane move, natural physics, cloth and hair respond to wind, real camera inertia
3d-realistic.tips: Best with image-to-video models; generate the hero still first and animate from it.

3d-cartoon.name: 3D animated feature
3d-cartoon.tagline: Big-eyed, soft-lit 3D animation like a family feature film.
3d-cartoon.look: stylized 3D animated feature film look, soft subsurface skin, big expressive eyes, rounded shapes, warm key light with rim light, rich saturated color, gentle depth of field
3d-cartoon.character: an original stylized 3D character with exaggerated proportions, a large head, expressive eyebrows and a simple memorable outfit
3d-cartoon.finish: polished family-film render, soft global illumination
3d-cartoon.negative: photoreal, gritty, horror, anime, flat 2D, text, logos, watermark, known animation characters, studio names
3d-cartoon.motion: squash and stretch, bouncy anticipation before every action, expressive faces
3d-cartoon.tips: Never name an animation studio in the prompt; describe the qualities instead.

anime.name: Anime
anime.tagline: Cel-shaded Japanese animation: painted skies, speed lines, dramatic close-ups.
anime.look: anime style key visual, clean cel shading, crisp line art, hand-painted background with dramatic sky, lens flare, vibrant colors
anime.character: an original anime-style character with large detailed eyes, distinctive hair color and shape, and a recognizable outfit
anime.finish: high-quality anime film frame, sharp lines, soft gradient shadows
anime.negative: 3D render, photo, western cartoon, blurry lines, text, logos, watermark, existing anime characters
anime.motion: dramatic hair and cloth flutter, speed lines on fast moves, hold frames on emotional beats
anime.tips: Keep the hair color and outfit words identical in every prompt; that is what holds the character.

claymation.name: Claymation
claymation.tagline: Stop-motion clay: thumbprints, tiny sets, a hand-made jitter.
claymation.look: stop-motion claymation, characters sculpted from plasticine with visible fingerprints and tool marks, miniature handmade set, felt and cardboard props, soft studio lighting, tilt-shift miniature depth
claymation.character: an original clay puppet with a lumpy rounded body, bead eyes and simple clay clothing
claymation.finish: macro photo of a real miniature set, slight imperfections
claymation.negative: CGI, smooth plastic, photo of real people, anime, text, logos, watermark
claymation.motion: choppy stop-motion movement at twelve frames per second, slight surface boil between frames
claymation.tips: The 12 fps cut and the jitter do half the work; still images look surprisingly like stop-motion.

pixel-art.name: Pixel art
pixel-art.tagline: 16-bit retro game art with a limited palette and hard pixels.
pixel-art.look: 16-bit pixel art, limited color palette, hard-edged pixels, dithered shading, side-view game scene, parallax background layers
pixel-art.character: an original pixel-art sprite character with a clear silhouette and a two-color outfit
pixel-art.negative: smooth gradients, 3D, photo, blur, anti-aliasing, text, logos, watermark, existing game sprites
pixel-art.motion: sprite animation loops of four frames, parallax scrolling, screen shake on impacts
pixel-art.tips: Even a non-pixel image becomes pixel art in the cut: the pixelate filter snaps it to a grid.

low-poly.name: Low poly
low-poly.tagline: Faceted geometric 3D with flat shading and pastel light.
low-poly.look: low poly 3D art, faceted geometric shapes, flat-shaded triangles, minimal clean scene, soft pastel gradient sky, diorama composition
low-poly.character: an original low-poly character made of a few dozen flat-shaded facets
low-poly.finish: clean isometric render, crisp polygon edges
low-poly.negative: high detail, photo, textures, noise, text, logos, watermark
low-poly.motion: smooth floating camera, objects assemble from triangles
low-poly.tips: Works well as a calm, explainer-style series look.

comic.name: Comic book
comic.tagline: Inked panels, halftone dots and bold action framing.
comic.look: comic book panel art, bold black ink outlines, halftone dot shading, flat bright colors, dramatic foreshortened angles, action lines
comic.character: an original comic-book hero or everyday character with a bold silhouette and a signature color
comic.finish: printed comic page texture, crisp ink
comic.negative: photo, 3D render, soft blur, speech bubbles with text, letters, logos, watermark, existing superheroes
comic.motion: panel-to-panel cuts, impact frames, camera snaps to the action
comic.tips: Put any words in the captions, never in the image; models misspell speech bubbles.

watercolor.name: Watercolor storybook
watercolor.tagline: Soft painted pages from a children's book.
watercolor.look: watercolor storybook illustration, soft washes and blooms, visible paper grain, delicate pencil line, gentle light, cozy composition
watercolor.character: an original storybook character with simple round features and a soft pastel outfit
watercolor.finish: hand-painted on cold-press paper, white paper showing through
watercolor.negative: 3D, photo, hard shadows, neon, text, letters, logos, watermark
watercolor.motion: slow page-turn pacing, gentle parallax between painted layers
watercolor.tips: Perfect for bedtime stories and kids' explainers.

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk neon
cyberpunk.tagline: Rain, neon and chrome in a night city of the future.
cyberpunk.look: cyberpunk night city, rain-soaked streets, neon signs reflected in puddles, holographic haze, chrome and glass, high contrast magenta and cyan lighting, cinematic wide lens
cyberpunk.character: an original character with a reflective jacket, a small glowing implant and a distinctive haircut
cyberpunk.finish: moody cinematic frame, wet reflections, light bloom
cyberpunk.negative: daylight, pastoral, cartoon, readable signs, text, letters, logos, watermark
cyberpunk.motion: slow drone flight between towers, flickering neon, rain streaks
cyberpunk.tips: Ask for 'unreadable glowing signs' so the model does not attempt words.

paper-cutout.name: Paper cutout
paper-cutout.tagline: Layered craft paper with real shadows, like a pop-up book.
paper-cutout.look: layered paper cutout art, craft paper with torn edges, real drop shadows between layers, pop-up book diorama, soft top light
paper-cutout.character: an original flat paper puppet character with visible split-pin joints
paper-cutout.finish: macro photo of a handmade paper diorama
paper-cutout.negative: 3D CGI, photo of people, glossy, text, letters, logos, watermark
paper-cutout.motion: layers slide past each other, puppets hinge at their joints
paper-cutout.tips: Folk tales and history explainers look great in this style.

documentary.name: Nature documentary
documentary.tagline: Real-looking footage with a handheld camera and natural light.
documentary.look: documentary photograph, natural available light, telephoto wildlife lens or handheld 35mm, authentic environment, true-to-life color
documentary.character: an ordinary adult person in practical everyday clothing, candid and unposed
documentary.negative: illustration, cartoon, CGI look, oversaturated, posed studio, text, logos, watermark
documentary.motion: handheld camera breathing, slow telephoto pans, natural movement
documentary.tips: Pair with a calm narrator voice file.

noir.name: Film noir
noir.tagline: Black and white, hard shadows, blinds and cigarette smoke.
noir.look: 1940s film noir, black and white, hard low-key lighting, venetian blind shadows, smoke and fog, dutch angles, wet streets
noir.character: an original character in a trench coat and brimmed hat, face half in shadow
noir.finish: silver gelatin film frame, deep blacks
noir.negative: color, cartoon, bright daylight, text, letters, logos, watermark
noir.motion: slow push into faces, shadows sliding across walls
noir.tips: Mystery and true-crime stories fit this style.

horror.name: Found-footage horror
horror.tagline: Night-vision green, shaky camera, something in the dark.
horror.look: found footage horror still, night vision or weak flashlight, heavy darkness, desaturated sickly green tint, motion blur, empty corridors and woods
horror.character: an original frightened adult seen from behind or in silhouette
horror.negative: gore, blood, bright colors, cartoon, text, timestamps, logos, watermark
horror.motion: shaky handheld, sudden whip pans, flashlight sweeps
horror.tips: Suggest, never show. Keep it free of gore so it stays platform-safe.
